stops.title: Wo nhwɛmu
stops.caption: Asɔre mmaa nyinaa prɛko.
stops.speech: Yei ne sohwɛfoɔ nhwɛmu. Asɔre Nkwa kan asɔre mmaa nyinaa prɛko, na Ɛhia Wo kyerɛ deɛ ɛretwɛn obi ɛnnɛ.

stops.title: Asɔre Mmaa
stops.caption: Yɛ wɔn, hyehyɛ wɔn, yi wɔn.
stops.speech: Asɔre mmaa yɛ wo nko ara dea. Sohwɛfoɔ nko ara na ɔyɛ bi, de kɔ ɔmantam foforɔ mu, anaa ɔyi bi firi adwuma mu.

stops.title: Asɔre baa bi mu
stops.caption: Ne ho nsɛm, ne hwan na ɔdi anim.
stops.speech: Bue asɔre baa bi na hyɛ ne nsɛm ne n’akannifoɔ. Sɔfopanin a wobɔ ne din wɔ ha na ɛma ɔhunu saa asɔre baa no ahobammɔ nhwɛmu.

stops.title: Amantam
stops.caption: Mmeaeɛ a wɔde w’asɔre mmaa hyehyɛ mu.
stops.speech: Amantam de asɔre mmaa hyehyɛ mmeaeɛ so. Yɛ ɔmantam no kane; wontumi nyɛ asɔre baa kɔsi sɛ ne ɔmantam wɔ hɔ.

stops.title: Ɔpene nhwɛmu
stops.caption: Obiara nnuru mu kɔsi sɛ obi bue.
stops.speech: Obiara a ɔkyerɛw ne din ankasa twɛn wɔ ha. Pene no so na ɔnya akwannya nyinaa; po no na wɔyi n’akawnt.

stops.title: Hwan na ɔkura deɛn
stops.caption: Tumi, na ɛnyɛ dibea din.
stops.speech: Bue ɔmanfoɔ bi na hwɛ ne tumi so. Kairos kora nhyehyɛeɛ dibea mmienu pɛ, enti biribiara foforɔ firi tumi mu.

stops.title: Asɔremufoɔ adesua
stops.caption: Asɔre no nyinaa dea; asɔre baa tumi nnuru so.
stops.speech: Asɔremufoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ yɛ asɔre no nyinaa dea. Akuo no gye nnipa firi asɔre mmaa nyinaa so, enti ɛhia asɔre no nyinaa tumi.

stops.title: Nkaeɛbɔ a ɛtra asɔre mmaa so
stops.caption: Nhwɛmu korɔ a ɛtoto asɔre mmaa.
stops.speech: Nkaeɛbɔ ne nhwɛmu a ɛtra asɔre mmaa so. Wo nko ara ne dibea a wohunu asɔre baa biara bɔ mu, na ɛnyɛ baako baako.

stops.title: Wo kasa
stops.caption: Kairos ne nwoma yi, wɔ kasa nnan mu.
stops.speech: Kairos ka Borɔfo, Frɛnkye, Krio ne Twi. Sesa no firi nkyekyɛmu no mu, na nwoma no bue wɔ kasa korɔ no ara mu.
